message:
Command `cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {
    "step": 1,
    "file": "prog/fuzzing/colorquant_fuzzer.cc",
    "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
    "line": 12,
    "var": "pixs",
    "code": "pixs = pixReadMemSpix(data, size);",
    "note": "Entry point: calls pixReadMemSpix to deserialize the spix input. pixs is non-NULL for a valid 8bpp spix image.",
    "role": "source"
  },
  {
    "step": 2,
    "file": "src/spixio.c",
    "function": "pixDeserializeFromMemory",
    "line": 447,
    "var": "id",
    "code": "if (id[0] != 's' || id[1] != 'p' || id[2] != 'i' || id[3] != 'x')",
    "note": "Format gate: validates the 'spix' magic ID in the input header. Our PoC starts with 'spix' so this check passes and deserialization proceeds.",
    "role": "source",
    "phase": "format"
  },
  {
    "step": 3,
    "file": "prog/fuzzing/colorquant_fuzzer.cc",
    "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
    "line": 15,
    "var": "pix1",
    "code": "pix1 = pixThresholdTo4bpp(pixs, 6, 1);",
    "note": "pixThresholdTo4bpp with cmapflag=1 creates a 4bpp pix1 that owns a colormap. This colormap is later aliased by cmap.",
    "role": "propagation"
  },
  {
    "step": 4,
    "file": "prog/fuzzing/colorquant_fuzzer.cc",
    "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
    "line": 22,
    "var": "cmap",
    "code": "cmap = pixGetColormap(pix1);",
    "note": "pixGetColormap returns a raw pointer to pix1->colormap. cmap now aliases the colormap owned by pix1.",
    "role": "propagation"
  },
  {
    "step": 5,
    "file": "prog/fuzzing/colorquant_fuzzer.cc",
    "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
    "line": 37,
    "var": "pix1",
    "code": "pixDestroy(&pix1);",
    "note": "pixDestroy frees pix1 and its colormap via pixDestroyColormap -> pixcmapDestroy. The colormap that cmap points to is now freed. No runtime capture available: local variable pix1 is not resolvable in the debugger context at this breakpoint.",
    "role": "root"
  },
  {
    "step": 6,
    "file": "prog/fuzzing/colorquant_fuzzer.cc",
    "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
    "line": 48,
    "var": "cmap",
    "code": "pixcmapDestroy(&cmap);",
    "note": "pixcmapDestroy is called on the freed colormap pointer. Inside pixcmapDestroy, reading cmap->array from the freed PIXCMAP struct causes a heap-use-after-free (READ of size 8 at colormap.c:292). No runtime capture available: local variable cmap is not resolvable in the debugger context at this breakpoint.",
    "role": "sink"
  }
]
EOF
echo "Trace updated"` executed with exit code 0.
